title: Left or right
starting_code: # One door is locked and the other is not, but which?
hints: Two ways: in each, a different door is locked. The same program must get through both.
Ask `left_door.locked`: under the `if`, take the right door; under the `else`, the left.
Each way is a walk to the door, `open()`, then down and along to the stair.
intro: Two doors, and I keep one of them locked. Which one? That changes from night to night.
